reason: I hunt easy claims when a TikTok puts one in my face, but I almost never file because the checks are like $10. A free list of more settlements I still have to read and submit myself does not change that math.
objection: The payouts are pocket change and I still have to open the official notice, figure out if I even qualify, and file on some administrator site. That is a chore for ten bucks.
would_change_my_mind: Show me a specific no-proof claim I clearly qualify for that pays at least $50 and takes two minutes, not another directory of tiny checks I have to process myself.
